findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: binance_get_realtime_liquidations · Private data: binance_get_tool_catalog, whalescope_full_pipeline, hyperliquid_get_whale_wallet_positions · Public sink: binance_backtest_signal · Destructive: binance_set_pair_threshold, binance_detect_mm_activity, whalescope_compare_funding_across_exchanges, whalescope_compare_orderbook_depth.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: binance_get_realtime_liquidations · Private data: binance_get_tool_catalog, whalescope_full_pipeline, hyperliquid_get_whale_wallet_positions · Public sink: binance_backtest_signal · Destructive: binance_set_pair_threshold, binance_detect_mm_activity, whalescope_compare_funding_across_exchanges, whalescope_compare_orderbook_depth

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
